# Take It AIzy

> Take It AIzy is an Israeli company that builds custom management systems, WhatsApp customer-service bots and AI agents for small and medium businesses and organizations, and runs hands-on AI workshops for teams and managers. Work is done in Hebrew. The first needs call is free of charge.

Take It AIzy היא חברה ישראלית שבונה לעסקים ולארגונים מערכות ניהול בהתאמה אישית, בוטים לשירות לקוחות בוואטסאפ וסוכני AI, ומעבירה סדנאות AI לצוותים ולמנהלים. שיחת האפיון הראשונה ללא עלות.

Website: https://takeitaizy.dev/
Contact: hello@takeitaizy.dev, or the form at https://takeitaizy.dev/#contact
Languages: Hebrew (primary), English
Area served: Israel
Legal entity: אושר סולושיינס בע״מ (Osher Solutions Ltd.)

## What we build

- Custom management systems (מערכות ניהול בהתאמה אישית): one system built around how the business works, with the screens it needs, permissions per person, and connections to the tools it already has.
- A smart WhatsApp agent (אייג׳נט חכם לוואטסאפ), a customer-service bot: answers customers in Hebrew, collects documents and photos, opens a ticket, writes it straight into the business's CRM and updates the customer. Anything sensitive waits for a person to approve.
- AI agents (סוכני AI): follow information sources every day, read documents, and send a short summary of what changed.
- Back-office automation (אוטומציה של המשרד האחורי): reports, payments, invoices and documents handled without retyping.
- AI workshops (סדנאות AI): a lecture (1-2 hours), a hands-on workshop (2-5 hours, up to 10 people) or a field day (5 hours, on site), on Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and Copilot.

## Who it is for

Small and medium businesses and organizations in Israel with repetitive manual work and no in-house IT team. Among our clients: importers, service and supply companies, eCommerce companies, contractors and tradespeople, clubs and communities, real estate developers, accountants, personal development coaches, private tutors and schools, local authorities and business owners.

## How we work

1. A free needs call: we map each manual task and what it costs a month, and say what is worth building first. If off-the-shelf software solves the problem, we say so.
2. Setup: a staged build starting with the biggest pain, a rollout where sensitive actions wait for the client's approval, training and going live. Priced as a fixed quote after the needs call.
3. Maintenance and changes for a fixed monthly fee. The same team scopes, builds and supports the system.

## Examples of systems we built (client names withheld on purpose)

- A service and maintenance company: service calls used to arrive as WhatsApp messages that the CEO turned into customer reports by hand. Now every technician documents each call in a personal app, the office approves, and a PDF report and a billing summary come out of it.
- A home appliances company: a smart WhatsApp agent that identifies the product, asks for a photo or invoice, assigns a technician by area and writes every inquiry straight into the client's CRM.
- A landscaping contractor: quotes built from a price list as a ready PDF, and email reminders before a vehicle's inspection or insurance expires.
- A professional club for finance people: a complete paid members platform with sign-up, payments, renewals, invoices, protected video, event registration and a store of AI tools.
- A real estate investor: a research agent that emails every morning what changed in planning databases.
